headline: Eighteen degrees after sunset.
body: The hour settles at eighteen degrees under mostly cloudy cover. Southwest wind runs near twelve kilometres an hour, pressure steady near one thousand nineteen. Dry paving and evening traffic; lamps are on now that the light has gone.

pulses.label: Sky
pulses.value: mostly cloudy, 18°C, SW 12 km/h, 1019 hPa steady
